description: Stops cloud monitoring for one playlist on the signed-in Premium account. The daily follower snapshot, the spike and drop alert emails and the track-removed alert all stop for that playlist on this account, and it disappears from list_monitors. Returns { ok, message, playlistId }. Side effects: deletes this account's monitor entry, including its custom name and track_id. Follower snapshots already stored for the playlist are kept and still appear in check_playlist, and other accounts monitoring the same playlist are unaffected. Reversible with add_monitor, but the name and track_id have to be supplied again. Idempotent: removing a playlist that is not monitored still returns ok: true. Use it to free a slot when the account is at the 25-monitor limit, or to change a monitor's name or tracked track (there is no update tool, so remove it and call add_monitor with the new values). Call list_monitors first if you need the exact playlist id. Requires Premium (£14.99/mo) and a signed-in account: returns FORBIDDEN on other tiers, UNAUTHORIZED without an account, and INVALID_PARAMS for a link that is not a playlist.

playlist.description: The monitored playlist to stop tracking, as a share URL ("https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1PmwMQY86pJuAm7veFt3u2"), a URI ("spotify:playlist:1PmwMQY86pJuAm7veFt3u2") or the bare 22-character id that list_monitors returns as playlist_id ("1PmwMQY86pJuAm7veFt3u2").

name: remove_monitor
